class.name: JRPGCommandList
class.brief_description: A list of event commands, stored packed.
class.description: What an event page, a common event or a troop page runs, and the branches of branch commands. It stores its commands packed in one property ([member data]: one [code][lb]code, parameters, child lists[rb][/code] entry per command), so maps with many commands load fast, and builds the [JRPGEventCommand] objects the first time they are read; editing them changes what is packed next. Child lists stay packed until they are read too. Authority: server. Online, the zone runs the lists; clients only see presentation requests.

method.name: get_command_count
method.description: Returns how many commands the list has.

method.name: get_commands
method.description: Returns the commands, built from the packed data the first time.

method.name: get_content_hash
method.description: Returns a 64-bit hash of the packed commands, child lists included: any change at any depth changes it. A saved interpreter records it to notice a list edited since the save.

method.name: insert_command
method.description: Inserts [param command] at [param index] (at the end when [code]-1[/code]).

members.member: The packed commands, as saved: built from the commands when they have been read, so it always holds the list as it is.
